spans.s: --a weapon peculiar to बलराम; reached him during the siege of मथुरा. भा. X. ५०. ११ [१५]; वा. २३. १९९; Vi. V. २२. 7.
(II)--an आन्ध्र king; ruled for five years (one year-ब्र्। प्। and वा। प्।); with him are twelve (पञ्चसप्तक) kings. M. २७३. 9; Br. III. ७४. १६५; वा. ९९. ३५२.

(also लाङ्गलि and बलदेव)--बलराम, brother of कृष्ण; took कृष्ण to task for not getting syamantaka after killing Bhoja and went to मिथिला where he was honoured by its king; Duryodhana learnt गदा from him here; taken back to द्वारका by कृष्ण. Br. III. ७१. ६६. ८०. ८५; Vi. V. २८. ११. [page३-757+ २७]

(I)--the poison that first issued from the अमृतमथन. शिव consumed it with पार्वति's permission. That which was split became poisonous scorpions, serpents, cobras and other plants;
1: भा.
(II)--the XI battle between the Gods and the Asuras. Br. III. ७२. ७५, ८६.
(IV)--a son of अरिष्टकर्मन्, and father of Palalaka. Vi. IV. २४. ४६-7.
--a son of अरिष्टकर्मन्, and father of Talaka. भा.
